direct_torque_version_note: Direct Torque Control V2 was introduced in 5.25.1 and is inherited by the 5.25.2 target release.
readonly_preflight: read controller and robot serial numbers
read TCP and payload including center of gravity
read calibration identity and checksum where available
determine whether PROFIsafe is installed or configured
inventory programs, installations, safety configuration, network, Dashboard, and RTDE state

backup_requirements.applicability: historical 5.25.2 install gate retained for audit; no new backup is required because no install will occur

mandatory_stop_conditions: the probed current version is newer than 5.25.2, so installing the target would be a prohibited downgrade
controller or robot identity does not match the expected bench
complete backup or Support File is missing or unreadable
any backup or URUP checksum is missing or mismatched
an installed URCap is incompatible with 5.25.2 or compatibility is unresolved
PROFIsafe use is detected and the 5.25.0 active-low outgoing-signal breaking change is not explicitly reconciled
Safety is not NORMAL before maintenance
the official update path does not apply to the probed current version
historical_5_25_2_post_upgrade_readback_: serials, installation, calibration, TCP, payload, and safety configuration match the signed backup manifest
OnRobot, External Control, and every other inventoried URCap load without incompatibility
Dashboard, RTDE, and network readback pass
direct_torque V2, Jacobian, and dynamics APIs are present
no program is played and no bridge or torque session is started during verification
controller_verified_transition: set true only after every post-upgrade readback item has hash-bound evidence
